_note: Component props follow upstream's InlineComponent order: the implicit children prop (added for non-snippet body content) comes first, even when the user also passes children, so an explicit children attribute is a duplicate key (TS1117 at the attribute; the same holds at the name of a {#snippet children} next to body content, which additionally is Svelte's snippet_conflict compiler error and so is not part of this fixture). Every snippet prop, children included, is destructured from the component's $$prop_def inside the component block, so {@render children()} there reads the component's optional children type (TS2722). Duplicate keys in a component's props literal are not dropped by the element-attribute duplicate filter. Verified against upstream svelte-check --tsgo with svelte 5.55.
